summary.text: Nicole Collier is a Democratic state representative from Texas House District 95 who has served since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Ballotpedia lists no opponent.

paragraphs.text: Nicole Collier earned a B.S. from the University of Houston in 1996, according to Ballotpedia.
She assumed office in the Texas House in 2013.
She chaired the Criminal Jurisprudence Committee in 2019-2022, and for 2023-2024 was assigned to the Culture, Recreation, & Tourism and Public Health committees.
